answer: Conductance-threshold admission resists sybils: an identity is admitted only if the cut separating it from the honest core has high conductance (many edges relative to cluster size), which a sybil region joined by few attack edges cannot meet. A tundra of fakes forms a low-conductance pocket behind a thin edge bundle; the vault of honest trust is high-conductance. A river of sybils cannot raise their cut's conductance without forging many genuine honest edges, so the signature keeps the fake cluster below threshold.
